verdict.rationale: The evidence includes the public LibreOffice/core GitHub repository, whose README covers SDK and build/runtime details, and a community commenter describes LibreOffice as open source. That indicates the source is readable. However, no item names the license or states its terms, so the 'open license' part of the story rests on implication. Missing for 10: explicit license identification and terms in first-party evidence, and direct documentation of source access and how to obtain the code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
